title: Departure airport must be supplied
why: Verifies the departure airport reference is mandatory and must resolve to an Airport.

steps.does: POST …/flight with otherwise valid data and DepartureAirportId set first to the empty guid, then to an unknown guid 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111

expect: Both rejected with an error on DepartureAirportId; nothing is saved.
